title: Open All Windows Apps Instantly! 🤯 | Hidden Windows Run Command

Open All Windows Apps Instantly! 🤯 | Hidden Windows Run Command

Discover a hidden Windows command that lets you access your installed applications in one place! 🚀

In this quick Windows tip, learn how to use shell:appsfolder to open the Applications folder on your Windows PC.

💻 How to use it:

Press Windows + R.

Type shell:appsfolder.

Press Enter.

Explore your Windows applications in one place!
